# MissingIssetImplementation

<Badge type="danger" text="error" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" />

Group: [Probable bugs](/rules/#probable-bugs) · PhpStorm name: `MissingIssetImplementationInspection`

`isset($obj->name)` / `empty($obj->name)` on a property the class does not
declare can only answer correctly if the class implements `__isset()`. When it
does not (typically classes with `__get` only), the check is always
false/empty, which is a silent logic bug.

## Example

```php{28,29}
<?php
class Profile
{
    public $nick;
    private $secret;
}

class Lazy
{
    public function __get($k) { return 1; }
    public function __isset($k) { return true; }
}

class Bag
{
    public function __get($k) { return null; }

    public function probe(): array
    {
        $p = new Profile();
        $l = new Lazy();
        $b = new Bag();
        $o = new \STDCLASS();
        $k = 'x';
        return [
            isset($p->nick),
            isset($l->anything),
            isset($b->color, $b->{$k}),
            empty($b->size),
            empty($b->$k),
            isset($this->dynamic),
            isset($o->field),
            isset(Bag::${$k}),
        ];
    }
}
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 28: \Bag has no __isset(); this isset/empty check is always false.</li>
<li>line 29: \Bag has no __isset(); this isset/empty check is always false.</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "MissingIssetImplementation": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore MissingIssetImplementation

/**
 * @noinspection MissingIssetImplementationInspection
 */
```
